title: Air Force retires iconic Huey helicopters as Black Hawks take over

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Air Force (PAF) has retired its last six operational UH-1H helicopters after newer Black Hawks took over most of their transport and disaster-response missions. PAF spokesperson Col. Alvin Jay Capinguian said on Friday that all six helicopters were still operational before their formal decommissioning on Thursday at Brig. Gen. Benito N. Ebuen Air Base in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu. However, the helicopters, commonly known as Hueys, had largely been used for training in recent years as the S-70i Black Hawks assumed their previous duties.
